a.en: A good question can lead to a much deeper discussion.
a.zh: 一個好問題可以引導出更深入的討論。

a.m..en: The school library opens at nine a.m. on weekdays.
a.m..zh: 學校圖書館平日上午九點開門。

abandon.en: The hikers had to abandon their plan because of the storm.
abandon.zh: 登山客因為暴風雨而不得不放棄原本的計畫。

abbreviate.en: Writers often abbreviate long terms after introducing them clearly.
abbreviate.zh: 作者在清楚介紹長術語後，常會使用縮寫。

abide.en: All students must abide by the rules of the laboratory.
abide.zh: 所有學生都必須遵守實驗室規則。

ability.en: Practice can improve your ability to understand difficult reading passages.
ability.zh: 練習可以提升你理解困難閱讀文章的能力。

able.en: She was able to finish the report before the deadline.
able.zh: 她能夠在截止期限前完成報告。

abnormal.en: The doctor noticed an abnormal pattern in the test results.
abnormal.zh: 醫師注意到檢查結果中有異常的模式。

aboard.en: Everyone was safely aboard the train before it left the station.
aboard.zh: 火車離站前，每個人都已安全上車。

abolish.en: The school decided to abolish a rule that was no longer useful.
abolish.zh: 學校決定廢除一項已不再實用的規定。

aboriginal.en: The museum introduced aboriginal art from several regions of Taiwan.
aboriginal.zh: 博物館介紹了來自台灣數個地區的原住民藝術。

abortion.en: The textbook discussed abortion as a complex social and medical issue.
abortion.zh: 課本將墮胎作為一項複雜的社會與醫療議題來討論。

abound.en: Wildflowers abound in the valley during the warm spring months.
abound.zh: 溫暖的春季裡，山谷中遍布野花。

about.en: The class watched a short film about ocean pollution.
about.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋污染的短片。

above.en: The temperature stayed above thirty degrees throughout the afternoon.
above.zh: 整個下午氣溫都維持在三十度以上。

abroad.en: She hopes to study abroad after graduating from high school.
abroad.zh: 她希望高中畢業後到國外留學。

abrupt.en: An abrupt change in weather forced us to return early.
abrupt.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使我們提早返回。

absence.en: His absence from class made the group presentation more difficult.
absence.zh: 他的缺席讓小組報告變得更困難。

absent.en: Two students were absent because they were attending a competition.
absent.zh: 兩名學生因參加比賽而缺席。

absolute.en: There is no absolute answer to every question in social science.
absolute.zh: 社會科學中的每個問題都不一定有絕對答案。

absorb.en: Dark materials absorb more heat from sunlight than light materials.
absorb.zh: 深色材料比淺色材料吸收更多陽光的熱能。

abstract.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain an abstract idea.
abstract.zh: 老師用圖表來解釋一個抽象概念。

abstraction.en: The painting uses abstraction rather than realistic detail to express emotion.
abstraction.zh: 這幅畫以抽象手法而非寫實細節來表達情感。

absurd.en: It would be absurd to ignore all the evidence we collected.
absurd.zh: 忽略我們收集到的所有證據是很荒謬的。

abundance.en: The region is known for its abundance of fresh fruit.
abundance.zh: 這個地區以盛產新鮮水果聞名。

abundant.en: Clean water is abundant in some places but scarce in others.
abundant.zh: 乾淨的水在某些地方很充足，在其他地方卻很稀少。

abuse.en: The campaign teaches students how to recognize and report online abuse.
abuse.zh: 這項活動教導學生如何辨識並通報網路上的不當侵害。

academic.en: She received academic support when she struggled with mathematics.
academic.zh: 她在數學遇到困難時獲得了學業上的協助。

academy.en: He joined a summer academy that focused on science and engineering.
academy.zh: 他參加了一個以科學與工程為主的暑期學院課程。

accelerate.en: New technology can accelerate the process of collecting research data.
accelerate.zh: 新科技可以加快蒐集研究資料的過程。

accent.en: Her English accent changed slightly after living overseas for years.
accent.zh: 她在海外生活多年後，英語口音有些改變。

accept.en: We should accept useful feedback and learn from our mistakes.
accept.zh: 我們應該接受有用的回饋並從錯誤中學習。

acceptable.en: The teacher explained what level of evidence was acceptable for the report.
acceptable.zh: 老師說明了報告可接受的證據標準。

acceptance.en: The new policy gained wide acceptance among students and teachers.
acceptance.zh: 這項新政策獲得學生與教師的廣泛接受。

access.en: Students can access the online library with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以使用學校帳號進入線上圖書館。

accessible.en: The website was redesigned to make information more accessible to everyone.
accessible.zh: 網站重新設計，使資訊更容易讓所有人取得。

accessory.en: This small accessory lets the camera connect to a larger screen.
accessory.zh: 這個小配件可以讓相機連接到較大的螢幕。

accident.en: The road was closed for an hour after a minor accident.
accident.zh: 一場小事故後，道路封閉了一個小時。

accidental.en: The discovery was accidental, but it led to an important experiment.
accidental.zh: 這項發現是偶然的，卻促成了一個重要實驗。

acclaim.en: The young musician earned acclaim for her first public performance.
acclaim.zh: 這位年輕音樂家因首次公開演出而獲得讚譽。

accommodate.en: The hall can accommodate more than five hundred visitors at once.
accommodate.zh: 這座大廳一次可以容納五百多名訪客。

accommodation.en: The exchange program provides accommodation for students near the school.
accommodation.zh: 交換計畫為學生提供學校附近的住宿。

accompany.en: A teacher will accompany the students during the museum visit.
accompany.zh: 博物館參訪期間會有一位老師陪同學生。

accomplish.en: The team worked together to accomplish its goal before Friday.
accomplish.zh: 團隊合作在星期五前完成目標。

accomplishment.en: Finishing the difficult project gave her a strong sense of accomplishment.
accomplishment.zh: 完成這項困難的專題讓她很有成就感。

accord.en: The two groups reached an accord after several hours of discussion.
accord.zh: 兩個團體經過數小時討論後達成協議。

accordance.en: The experiment was conducted in accordance with the safety guidelines.
accordance.zh: 這項實驗依照安全規範進行。

accordingly.en: The weather forecast changed, so we adjusted our schedule accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 天氣預報改變，因此我們也相應調整了行程。

account.en: Please create an account before saving your progress online.
account.zh: 請先建立帳號，再儲存你的線上進度。

accountable.en: Group members should be accountable for the tasks they agree to complete.
accountable.zh: 小組成員應對自己答應完成的任務負責。

accountant.en: The accountant checked the records carefully before preparing the report.
accountant.zh: 會計人員在準備報告前仔細檢查了紀錄。

accounting.en: She became interested in accounting after taking a business course.
accounting.zh: 她修讀商業課程後開始對會計感興趣。

accumulate.en: Small errors can accumulate and affect the final result.
accumulate.zh: 小錯誤可能逐漸累積並影響最後結果。

accumulation.en: The accumulation of plastic waste has become a serious environmental problem.
accumulation.zh: 塑膠垃圾的累積已成為嚴重的環境問題。

accuracy.en: The researchers repeated the test to improve the accuracy of their measurements.
accuracy.zh: 研究人員重複測試，以提高測量的準確度。

accurate.en: Make sure the numbers are accurate before submitting the report.
accurate.zh: 提交報告前要確認數字正確。

accusation.en: The accusation was investigated before any decision was made.
accusation.zh: 在做出任何決定前，相關指控先接受了調查。

accuse.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without enough evidence.
accuse.zh: 在沒有足夠證據的情況下指控他人是不公平的。

accustom.en: It may take time to accustom yourself to a new schedule.
accustom.zh: 你可能需要一些時間讓自己適應新的作息。

ache.en: My shoulders began to ache after carrying the heavy bag all day.
ache.zh: 背著沉重的包包一整天後，我的肩膀開始痠痛。

achieve.en: Regular practice can help students achieve better results over time.
achieve.zh: 規律練習能幫助學生逐漸取得更好的成果。

achievement.en: Winning the science contest was a major achievement for the team.
achievement.zh: 贏得科學競賽是這個團隊的一項重大成就。

acid.en: The experiment showed how acid reacts with certain types of metal.
acid.zh: 實驗展示酸如何與某些種類的金屬反應。

acknowledge.en: The report should acknowledge the limits of the available data.
acknowledge.zh: 這份報告應承認現有資料的限制。

acquaintance.en: I met an old acquaintance while visiting the night market.
acquaintance.zh: 我逛夜市時遇到一位舊識。

acquire.en: Students acquire new skills faster when they practice them regularly.
acquire.zh: 學生規律練習時能更快習得新技能。

acquisition.en: Language acquisition usually requires both exposure and repeated practice.
acquisition.zh: 語言習得通常需要接觸與反覆練習。

acre.en: The farm includes an acre of land beside the river.
acre.zh: 這座農場包含河邊的一英畝土地。

across.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain became heavier.
across.zh: 雨勢變大前，我們走過了那座橋。

act.en: Students should act responsibly when using information from the internet.
act.zh: 學生使用網路資訊時應負責任地行事。

action.en: Quick action prevented the small problem from becoming much worse.
action.zh: 迅速採取行動避免小問題變得更嚴重。

active.en: Staying active can improve both physical health and concentration.
active.zh: 保持活躍有助於改善身體健康與專注力。

actively.en: Students learn more when they actively participate in class discussions.
actively.zh: 學生主動參與課堂討論時能學得更多。

activity.en: The teacher planned a short activity to review the new vocabulary.
activity.zh: 老師安排了一個簡短活動來複習新單字。

actor.en: The actor practiced the difficult scene several times before filming.
actor.zh: 這位演員在拍攝前把困難的場景練習了好幾次。

actress.en: The actress gave an interview about her latest film project.
actress.zh: 這位女演員接受訪問，談到她最新的電影計畫。

actual.en: The actual cost was lower than our original estimate.
actual.zh: 實際成本比我們原本的估算低。

actually.en: The task looked simple, but it was actually quite challenging.
actually.zh: 這項任務看似簡單，實際上相當有挑戰性。

adapt.en: Animals must adapt when their environment changes rapidly.
adapt.zh: 動物在環境快速改變時必須適應。

adaptation.en: The film is an adaptation of a well-known historical novel.
adaptation.zh: 這部電影改編自一部知名的歷史小說。

add.en: Please add your name to the list before leaving.
add.zh: 離開前請把你的名字加到名單上。

addition.en: The library's new study area is a useful addition to the school.
addition.zh: 圖書館的新自習區是學校一項實用的新設施。

additional.en: The teacher provided additional examples to make the idea clearer.
additional.zh: 老師提供更多例子，讓這個觀念更清楚。

address.en: The speaker will address several questions at the end of the talk.
address.zh: 講者會在演講最後回應幾個問題。

adequate.en: We need adequate time to check the data before publishing it.
adequate.zh: 我們需要足夠時間在發布資料前進行檢查。

adjust.en: You may need to adjust your study plan before the exam.
adjust.zh: 考試前你可能需要調整讀書計畫。

adjustment.en: A small adjustment to the schedule solved the timing problem.
adjustment.zh: 對行程做一點調整就解決了時間安排問題。

administer.en: Trained staff will administer the survey to all participating students.
administer.zh: 受過訓練的工作人員會對所有參與學生進行問卷調查。

administration.en: The school administration announced the new policy on Monday morning.
administration.zh: 校方在星期一早上宣布了新政策。

administrative.en: The office handles administrative tasks such as forms and scheduling.
administrative.zh: 這間辦公室處理表格與排程等行政工作。

admire.en: I admire people who remain calm during difficult situations.
admire.zh: 我很佩服在困難情況下仍能保持冷靜的人。

admission.en: Admission to the museum is free for students on Fridays.
admission.zh: 學生星期五可免費進入博物館。

admit.en: He was willing to admit his mistake and correct it.
admit.zh: 他願意承認自己的錯誤並加以改正。

adolescent.en: The study examined sleep habits among adolescent students.
adolescent.zh: 這項研究探討青少年學生的睡眠習慣。

adopt.en: The school plans to adopt a new online learning system.
adopt.zh: 學校計畫採用新的線上學習系統。

adoption.en: The adoption of digital tools changed how the class completed assignments.
adoption.zh: 採用數位工具改變了全班完成作業的方式。

adult.en: Every adult in the program received basic first-aid training.
adult.zh: 計畫中的每位成年人都接受了基礎急救訓練。

advance.en: Medical research continues to advance through international cooperation.
advance.zh: 醫學研究透過國際合作持續進步。

advanced.en: The course introduces advanced topics after students master the basics.
advanced.zh: 學生掌握基礎後，這門課會介紹較進階的主題。

advantage.en: One advantage of online resources is that they are easy to update.
advantage.zh: 線上資源的一個優點是容易更新。

adventure.en: The trip became an unexpected adventure when our train was delayed.
adventure.zh: 火車誤點後，這趟旅程變成了一場意外的冒險。

adverb.en: An adverb often describes how, when, or where an action happens.
adverb.zh: 副詞常用來描述動作如何、何時或在哪裡發生。

advertise.en: The club used posters to advertise its upcoming school event.
advertise.zh: 社團用海報宣傳即將舉行的校內活動。

advertisement.en: The advertisement used bright images to attract young customers.
advertisement.zh: 這則廣告使用鮮明圖片吸引年輕顧客。

advice.en: Her advice helped me organize my study schedule more effectively.
advice.zh: 她的建議幫助我更有效率地安排讀書時間。

advise.en: Teachers often advise students to review difficult material regularly.
advise.zh: 老師常建議學生定期複習困難的內容。

advocate.en: Many scientists advocate stronger action to protect natural habitats.
advocate.zh: 許多科學家主張採取更積極的行動保護自然棲地。

affair.en: The committee is responsible for student affair planning and campus events.
affair.zh: 這個委員會負責學生事務規劃與校園活動。

affect.en: Cold weather can affect how quickly some plants grow.
affect.zh: 寒冷天氣會影響某些植物的生長速度。

affection.en: The child showed affection for the dog by gently petting it.
affection.zh: 孩子輕輕撫摸小狗，表達對牠的喜愛。

afford.en: We cannot afford to waste time before the final deadline.
afford.zh: 在最後期限前，我們不能浪費時間。

afraid.en: She was afraid of making mistakes during her first speech.
afraid.zh: 她第一次演講時很害怕犯錯。

after.en: We discussed the results after everyone finished the experiment.
after.zh: 每個人完成實驗後，我們一起討論結果。

afternoon.en: The class will meet again tomorrow afternoon in the library.
afternoon.zh: 全班明天下午會在圖書館再次集合。

afterward.en: We finished the presentation and talked about the experience afterward.
afterward.zh: 我們完成報告後，又聊了聊這次經驗。

again.en: Please read the question again before choosing your final answer.
again.zh: 選擇最後答案前，請再讀一次題目。

against.en: The team played against a strong opponent in the final match.
against.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中對上一個強勁的對手。

age.en: People of every age can benefit from regular physical activity.
age.zh: 各個年齡層的人都能從規律運動中受益。

agency.en: The government agency released a report on air quality.
agency.zh: 政府機關發布了一份空氣品質報告。

agenda.en: The first item on today's agenda is the class project.
agenda.zh: 今天議程的第一項是班級專題。
